title: Straight-Line Tracking Drill
description: Players push the length of a marked line, correcting drift immediately so the chair tracks dead straight — a foundational skill that makes every other movement more efficient.

content.objective: Keep the chair tracking dead straight along a line, correcting any drift immediately.
content.setup: A sideline or a taped line marks the path; players push along it from one end to the other.
instructions: Push along the line using even strokes on both sides.
The instant the chair drifts off the line, correct with a slightly stronger push on one side.
Push the full length of the line without stopping.
Turn around and push back, focusing on the side that drifted most the first time.
coachingPoints: Make small, early corrections rather than big, late ones.
Keep the push rhythm even between both hands as the default.
Look ahead down the line, not down at the wheels.
commonMistakes: Over-correcting and zig-zagging across the line instead of tracking it smoothly.
Favouring the stronger side without noticing the drift it causes.
Losing the line and drifting off the intended path.
content.safety: Make sure the line's full length is clear of other players.
